title: Lead-Time Count for Returned Increase Addenda — Group Room Blocks
content:
The day from which the days before arrival of a Group Room Blocks increase are counted follows the increase addendum's return: when it was issued no more than 30 calendar days before the date it is implemented, the days are counted from its issue date; when it was issued more than 30 but no more than 60 calendar days before that date, they are counted from the day 30 calendar days after its issue date; when it was issued earlier than that, they are counted from the date it is implemented. The count runs in whole calendar days to the block's arrival date.

### Questions the rule answers

**What is the issue date?** The date the increase addendum was issued, as shown on the addendum record.

**An addendum issued 30 days before it is implemented: where does the count start?** At its issue date; 30 days is still within the first band.

**Issued 31 days before implementation?** At the day 30 calendar days after the issue date.

**Issued 60 days before implementation?** Still at the day 30 calendar days after the issue date.

**Issued 61 days before implementation?** At the implementation date itself.

### Worked count (hypothetical calendar: issued on day 0, arrival on day 120)

| Implemented on | Count starts | Days before arrival |
|---|---|---|
| day 10 | day 0 | 120 |
| day 40 | day 30 | 90 |
| day 70 | day 70 | 50 |
